title: Child and School-Child Additions for Temporary Total Months (Disability Compensation)
content:
**Clause.** The child additions in a Disability Compensation temporary total past-due are one child addition for each recorded minor child plus one school-child addition for each recorded school child when the award records both; one child addition for each recorded minor child when it records minor children and no school child; one school-child addition for each recorded school child when it records school children and no minor child; and nothing when it records no child. They apply to every temporary total month.

**Rates.** Every addition in a temporary total past-due is taken from the 100 percent tier: 146.10 for each minor child and 472.95 for each school child.

**Counting.** Minor children recorded are the child additions on the award less the child removals; school children recorded are the school-child additions less the school-child removals.

**Basis questions (hypothetical)**

*An award at Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating) records one minor child and one school child. What is added for each temporary total month?* 146.10 plus 472.95, that is 619.05 — the 100 percent tier amounts, not the 40 percent tier's.

*The award records two minor children and no school child?* 146.10 multiplied by 2, that is 292.20 a month.

*A school child was added and later removed at the age limit, and no other child is recorded?* Nothing.
